ui.slurp.settings.autopurge.detail: Keep Slurp storage under control by clearing old posts or their media after a retention period you choose.
ui.slurp.settings.autopurge.localOnlyDet: Autopurge never touches Engine characters, personas, other social data, generation connections, Creator avatars, or Creator banners.
ui.slurp.settings.autopurge.olderThanDet: The default is four weeks. Months follow calendar months rather than a fixed number of days.
ui.slurp.settings.autopurge.keepPostsDet: Remove old post and Story media, but keep the written posts, image prompts, comments, and unlock history. Turn this off to delete the complete old posts instead.
ui.slurp.settings.autopurge.includeMessa: Remove old image attachments from direct messages. Message text and conversation history always stay.
ui.slurp.settings.autopurge.scheduleDeta: Run this cleanup repeatedly. If Marinara Engine is offline when a purge is due, Slurp runs it the next time the package starts.
ui.slurp.settings.autopurge.nextRunDetai: After a purge finishes, the next one is scheduled one retention period later.
ui.slurp.settings.autopurge.runNowDetail: Use the retention window and cleanup choices above without turning on the schedule.

ui.slurp.site.say.hello1: Welcome to Slurp! I'm Slurp Support. Yes, all of us.
ui.slurp.site.say.hello2: I've opened a ticket for you. Don't worry, it's the nice kind.
ui.slurp.site.say.id1: Policy says I have to ask. Slurp is 18+.
ui.slurp.site.say.id2: Approved. Our finance team is very proud of that card.
ui.slurp.site.say.what1: Three things, then the form. One: your characters become Creators. They post, public or locked, and they stay themselves.
ui.slurp.site.say.what2: Two: the fans come with the place. They follow, like, comment, subscribe, tip and DM. The feed keeps moving while Marinara runs.
ui.slurp.site.say.what3: Three: you are the platform. Watch, post as your persona, or pull a few strings later in Stir.
ui.slurp.site.say.cost: And one plain reminder: every post, reply and picture is a call on your own AI connection. You can turn it down any time.
ui.slurp.site.say.locked1: Some posts are locked. Let me get our test Creator.
ui.slurp.site.q.coins: She does that. Anyway: unlock one post with Slurpcoins, or subscribe to see all of a Creator's locked posts. Your wallet fills up a little every day.
ui.slurp.site.say.coinsWhat: Slurpcoins are Slurp's own money. Your wallet tops up every day, and you earn a few more for watching ads and joining in. Finance made a chart. Nobody has read it.
ui.slurp.site.say.setup1: Now the form. Short, I promise. Forms are my favourite part.
ui.slurp.site.q.connection: Which AI should write for Slurp?
ui.slurp.site.say.noConnection: You have no AI connection yet, so nothing posts on its own for now. Add one in Marinara's Connections and I'll update your file.
ui.slurp.site.q.imageConnection: Which image connection should draw them?
ui.slurp.site.q.fun: That's the form. Got a minute for the fun part? It's optional. I'm required to say that.
ui.slurp.site.q.ads: Ads? They keep our lights on.
ui.slurp.site.q.pullStrings: Between us: want to pull strings?
ui.slurp.site.say.review1: Here's your member file. Change anything you like, then I stamp it. Nothing counts until the stamp.

ui.slurp.site.say.ratedLess: Noted. I'll raise it with my manager. I am my manager.
